title: DiscussionMetadata
description: Structured detail of a discussion message. Every field is optional: which fields a message carries depends on its messageType and on who sent it. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

signal.description: The signal an agent sent, the same as messageType. Sent on every agent signal and on the lifecycle signals.

role.description: The sending agent's discussion role, such as tooler or analyst. Sent on agent signals.

modelName.description: The model the sender's inference actually ran on. On an agent signal sent after its calls ran (agree, concern, or a stand-aside after triage or evaluation), the model the last call ran on, as the scheduler placed it; modelsUsed lists every place the calls ran. On triaging, the triage model the agent plans to use. On a signal sent before a call completed (evaluating, heartbeat, waiting, failure) and on the coordinator's review_ready, the model the sender is configured with. On the coordinator's advisory and advisory_ready, the model its advisory call ran on, with modelsUsed, or the configured model when no call is known.

modelsUsed.description: Each distinct place the model calls behind an agent signal ran, as model@server (the model alone when the call went to the agent's static endpoint), in call order. Sent with modelName when the calls ran.

model.description: The model an agent's call ran on, the same as modelName on agree and concern; on waiting and on a capacity stand-aside, the model the agent waits for or could not place.

gpuLabel.description: The accelerator the sender ran on, such as a ModelServer name; none when it ran on none. Absent on a signal sent before the sender's call is placed (triaging, evaluating, waiting, heartbeat): the scheduler picks the server when the call is made.

server.description: The ModelServer that served an agent's call, chosen when the call was made.

pickReason.description: Why the scheduler picked the server, as text.

evicted.description: Models the scheduler unloaded to make room for the call.

inferenceMs.description: Milliseconds spent in model calls for the message.

inferenceStartMs.description: When the agent's work for the signal started, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch; 0 when unknown.

loadDurationMs.description: Milliseconds the model server spent loading the model for the coordinator's advisory call. Older messages only; newer ones carry firstTokenMs and coldStart.

firstTokenMs.description: Milliseconds from sending the coordinator's advisory call to its first streamed token: reading the prompt, and loading the model first when coldStart is true.

coldStart.description: Whether the model had to load for the call that firstTokenMs times.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens of the model calls behind the message.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens of the model calls behind the message.

totalTokens.description: On an agent signal, inputTokens plus outputTokens. On thread_close, the coordinator's own token counts per step.

toolsUsed.description: The tools the agent has enabled, sent with agree. It lists what the agent could call, not the calls it made.

reason.description: Why: on stand_aside and waiting, gpu-busy, model-too-large or prompt-too-large; on gap_detected, the gap in words; on stop_requested, manual_stop; on a scheduled message, the reason it was scheduled.

predictorReason.description: The scheduler's explanation for a capacity stand-aside.

failureType.description: The kind of failure on a failure signal, such as same_tool_repeated, too_many_tool_failures, iterations_exhausted, loop_time_exceeded, model_timeout, model_oom, server_unreachable, internal_exception or evaluation_timeout.

harness.description: The name of the harness that produced the contribution, on a signal an agent's Moot Mesh sidecar sent for it.

harnessImage.description: The image, by digest when known, of the harness that produced the contribution.

turnMs.description: Milliseconds from handing the turn to the harness to its reply, measured by the sidecar.

evidence.description: What the harness says its answer rests on, as it reported it.

failedTool.description: The tool that failed, on a failure signal.

failureCount.description: On a failure signal, how many tool calls failed; on review_ready, how many agents sent failure.

lastError.description: The last error text of a failure, truncated.

exceptionClass.description: The Java exception class behind a failure that was not a tool failure.

synthesizedBy.description: Set to coordinator on a failure the coordinator sent for an agent that missed its deadline.

userQuery.description: The person's question, on thread_start, advisory_ready and review_ready.

primaryChannel.description: The channel the thread is answered on.

conversationId.description: The conversation a thread_start belongs to.

conversationContext.description: Earlier turns of the conversation, oldest first.

crew.description: The crew a thread_start belongs to.

crewVersion.description: The version of the crew chart that produced the thread, when the crew has one.

replayOf.description: The thread a dashboard replay repeats the question of.

technologies.description: The technologies the coordinator's advisory names.

layers.description: The layers of the system the coordinator's advisory names.

wisdom.description: The coordinator's advisory text, on advisory.

advisory.description: The coordinator's advisory text, on advisory_ready: the brief for the convened agents.

innerCircle.description: The agents the coordinator convened. Absent when every agent may take part.

triageConfidence.description: The coordinator's confidence in its choice of the inner circle.

selectedSkills.description: The skills the coordinator selected for the thread.

agents.description: The agents a triage_result selects, each with its confidence and reason.

overallConfidence.description: The coordinator's confidence in a triage_result as a whole.

agreeCount.description: How many agents sent agree, on review_ready.

concernCount.description: How many agents sent concern, on review_ready.

standAsideCount.description: How many agents sent stand_aside, on review_ready.

gapType.description: The gap a gap_detected names: agents that lack tools, no agent with the expertise, or tools that failed.

toolGapConcerns.description: On a TOOL_GAP, each agent's concern, by agent name.

onboarding.description: Set on messages from an onboarding agent.

consentAck.description: Set on an onboarding agent's agree to a proposal.

scheduleId.description: The schedule a scheduled message comes from.

kind.description: The kind of a scheduled message: reminder or followup.

sourceThreadId.description: The thread a scheduled message continues.

originalSourceThreadId.description: The thread a scheduled message would have continued, when it starts a new thread instead.

degraded.description: Set when a scheduled message starts a new thread because it could not continue its source thread.

placementCalls.description: The model calls behind an agent signal, in call order, each with where the scheduler placed it, why, what it predicted and what the call measured. Sent with modelsUsed when the calls ran.

receipt.description: On thread_close, what the thread cost and how it went.

DiscussionReceipt.title: DiscussionReceipt
DiscussionReceipt.description: What one thread cost and how it went, from the coordinator's view. Times are milliseconds; startedAt and settledAt are epoch milliseconds, and the other times count from the thread's start as the coordinator received its messages. It is a snapshot at the close. A reply that reopens the thread starts a new round, and the next close carries that round's receipt.

startedAt.description: When the coordinator saw the thread start.

settledAt.description: When the coordinator closed the thread.

firstSignalMs.description: From start to the first agent's terminal signal; absent when no agent signalled.

phasesMs.description: Time in each phase: advisory to the advisory, selection to the triage result, evaluation from the end of selection (or the first agent signal, when earlier) to the last signal, synthesis to the close. A phase the thread skipped is absent.

evaluation.description: To the last agent's terminal signal.

consensus.description: Who was convened and how they signalled.

convened.description: The larger of the agents the coordinator selected and the agents that signalled.

agree.description: Agents whose last terminal signal was agree.

tokens.description: Tokens the thread used: the agents' calls behind their signals, the coordinator's own advisory, triage and synthesis, and the sums.

agentsIn.description: Input tokens of the agents' calls.

agentsOut.description: Output tokens of the agents' calls.

agents.description: One line per agent that sent a terminal signal, in the order they signalled.

placements.description: How many agents' calls ran at each model@server.

calls.description: Every model call the scheduler placed in the round, the coordinator's and the agents', in the order they started. Each says where it ran, which policy placed it and why, the options it weighed, what was predicted, and what was measured. Absent when no call reported its placement.

ReceiptAgent.title: ReceiptAgent
ReceiptAgent.description: One agent's part in a thread.

signal.description: Its last terminal signal in the round; contribution counts as agree and decline as stand_aside.

atMs.description: From the thread's start to that signal.

models.description: Where its calls ran, as model@server, from the signal's modelsUsed.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens of its calls over the round; 0 when not reported.

outputTokens.description: Output tokens of its calls; 0 when not reported.

inferenceMs.description: Time in model calls; 0 when not reported.

waitMs.description: Time it spent waiting for an accelerator, from its first waiting message to its next evaluating message or terminal signal.

reason.description: The reason it gave, or for a failure its last error; at most 300 characters.

ReceiptPlacement.title: ReceiptPlacement
ReceiptPlacement.description: A model@server and how many agents' calls ran there.

place.description: model@server, or the model alone for a static endpoint.

agents.description: Agents with at least one call there.

tool.description: The tool the evidence came from.

TokenTotals.title: TokenTotals
TokenTotals.description: The coordinator's token counts by step: advisory, triage and synthesis.

query.description: The question of an earlier turn.

response.description: The answer of an earlier turn, truncated.

confidence.description: The coordinator's confidence in the agent.

reason.description: Why the coordinator selected the agent.
